reason: The logistics are feasible, but the idea cannot reach a scored probe with >= 70% probability under its own pre-registered gate. My estimate is P(scored before 29 Sep 10:00 UTC) ~0.2-0.25. That is P(logistics) ~0.85 x P(gate pass) ~0.25 (a guess) x P(slot + user OK) ~0.95. CHECKED FACTS: (1) The detector reads zarr_arr[t, ::dz, ::dy, ::dx] (tools/repo/scripts/predict_unet_transformer.py l.209-222), so the claim holds. (2) There are 125,700 pairs <= 4 um among 313,205 kept and 4,830,941 all peaks (experiments/coordhead_retrain/out_full_P/report.txt, line 1). (3) x138's refine(ds_path, t, arr, feature) (exp56 cell 4) receives the zarr path and t, so a full-res read inside a wrapper is implementable. (4) The laptop, not this container, holds the train zarr (tools/register_44b6_dorado.py DATA = ROOT/biohub-.../train; kdn run_local.py). It also holds the captures (coords + 224-d features, from which the public shift can be recomputed offline). Friend A is NOT on the path. WHY THE GATE, NOT THE CLOCK, IS BINDING: (a) The public head's leak5 bias is +0.35..+0.46 z, +0.23..+0.36 y, +0.24..+0.41 x um (report.txt). A residual fitted on (gt - public_refined) learns that intercept, 85% from 6bba. That fails the idea's own mean-shift gate (< 0.15 um per axis) by construction. With a centred, intercept-free fit only the variance part is left. (b) z carries ~66% of the error variance, and full res adds no z information (value sibling v_redteam-past_fullres-residual-head_value.json). So M1/M2 <= 0.95 x public in 3D needs a roughly 12-30% cut in xy sd on an UNSEEN embryo. The retrained UNet-feature head P gave 0% (44b6->6bba 1.570 vs 1.567) and +12% worse (6bba->44b6 1.452 vs 1.296). (c) The direct precedent is negative: Eric's sub-voxel peak refinement gave +0.0078 locally and -0.002 on the LB twice (research/wf_ideas_v3/browser_intel.md l.135). DEFECTS IN THE PLAN AS DESCRIBED: (i) The resources name 'agent-container', which has no data and no Kaggle access; everything must run on the user's laptop by the laptop agent. (ii) x138's refine raises RuntimeError('invalid V1284 displacement') when |shift| > 2.00001 um. Public (< 2 um) plus residual (< 1 um) can exceed that, so the residual must be added after refine returns, or the total must be re-bounded to <= 1.99 um. (iii) tools/build_probe_kernel.py --base x138 allows only divinsert|leafprune, so a new patch plus a byte-identity-when-off test is needed (~1.5-2 h). (iv) The 10%-on-dummy runtime check does not protect the hidden run. x138 takes 1,228 s on the 4 dummy clips (browser_intel.md l.82) and has a 27,000 s repair guard. My guess is that the extra full-frame reads add ~2-3% to the hidden run, which can push more movies past the guard, with no visible sign on the dummy clips. (v) The 'mean residual on the all-peak sample' must be computed on the same per-frame arr that refine sees (the ~4.8M candidates), not on the kept peaks. The time path itself is short: a scored probe by ~26 Sep 17:00 UTC leaves >2 days of slack.
fix_if_any: Run it as a zero-cost diagnostic first, and decide the probe only on that result. (1) On the laptop, training-free, <= 1.5 h: compute a pure full-res xy intensity centroid / parabola around the public-refined peak on the 125,700 pairs, with no fitting. Measure the debiased xy MAE and the 3D bias-free mean vs public PER EMBRYO. Continue only if each embryo shows a 3D cut >= 3% and an xy-sd cut >= 10%. (2) If you learn anything: xy only, per-video-centred targets, 44b6/6bba weighted 50/50, no intercept. Gate on both embryo-held-out directions as pre-registered. (3) In the kernel, wrap refine rather than editing its body: out = refine(...); read zarr[t] at full res once per frame from ds_path; add the residual in grid units (/4 in y and x), clipped so that |total shift| <= 1.99 um and the result stays inside feature.shape; ship the model as JSON ridge coefficients, not a sklearn pickle (docker sklearn version risk). Add it to build_probe_kernel.py as --base x138 --patch fullres, byte-identical to exp56 when off, and make it compose with divinsert. (4) Parity test on the laptop: run the kernel feature function and the lab extractor on the captured arr of 2 train videos and require identical features (no GPU needed). (5) Submit only if the gate passes, and preferably as a rider on a final that already needs a slot, since +0.001 is not resolvable on the public LB.
realistic_public_gain: ~+0.0005 (range -0.002..+0.002), conditional on shipping. Unconditionally ~0, because the gate most likely fails and nothing ships.
realistic_private_gain: ~0..+0.0005 (range -0.002..+0.002). The xy convention is embryo-specific (6bba +0.3..+0.4 um vs 44b6 ~0), so the transfer to unseen embryos may carry a sign risk.
critical_path: Machines: the user's Windows laptop (train zarr at repo root biohub-cell-tracking-during-development/train, captures in experiments/coordhead_retrain/captures, Kaggle CLI on vitaliineibauer, laptop agent at Idle priority) and Kaggle vitaliineibauer GPU (quota ~0 until the 26 Sep 00:00 UTC reset). Friend A and Colab are not needed. 25 Sep ~15-17 UTC: v3 synthesis and the user's pick. ~16:00-18:30: the laptop agent writes the extractor (captures -> public shift offline -> Hungarian pairs <= 4 um as in tools/train_coordhead.py -> 5x17x17 full-res patches at y,x = 4*grid + shift/0.40625) and runs a 2-video sanity check. 18:30-20:00: extraction over 199 videos (~167 GB decompressed, 4 workers; 0.5-1.5 h, a guess). 20:00-21:00: fit + gate (leak5 OOF + both embryo folds + mean shift on the refine-arr sample); GO/NO-GO ~21:00 (P ~0.25). In parallel 17-20 UTC: #34/#35 score and pick the base. If #34 < 0.953, the patch goes on exp51's coordhead module instead (+1 h). Before the user sleeps (~21:00 UTC), a conditional OK: 'submit if the gate and the dummy run pass'. 21:00-23:30: --patch fullres on --base x138, byte-identity-off test, parity test, private dataset upload of the JSON model. 26 Sep 00:00 GPU reset: push; dummy run COMPLETE ~00:45 (x138 1,228 s + ~5%). Check nodes within +/-3% of exp56, no RuntimeError, runtime +<= 10%. Submit ~01:00 (or ~07:00 UTC after the user wakes if there was no conditional OK); scored ~08:00-17:00 UTC 26 Sep. A one-day slip still lands ~27 Sep, so logistics are ~0.85 with >2 days of slack before 29 Sep 10:00 UTC. It competes with other v3 probes for the 5 slots on 26 Sep and the laptop agent's time on 25-26 Sep. Unconditional P(scored) ~0.2-0.25, set by the gate, not the clock.
